title: Protection Product Forms Charge on Vehicle Purchase Agreements Orders
content:
**Charge.** For a signed order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements that is not an exchange replacement, protection products sold with the vehicle add a product forms charge to the documentation fee. Two records decide it: whether a contract in KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts was sold with the vehicle on the order, and whether a plan in KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans is on the order.

| KestrelCare service contract sold with the vehicle | KestrelCare maintenance plan on the order | Product forms charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | $35.00 (the two-product forms charge) |
| yes | no | $20.00 (the one-product forms charge) |
| no | yes | $20.00 (the one-product forms charge) |
| no | no | none |

**Hypothetical cases.**
- A buyer adds KestrelCare Gold at purchase and a KestrelCare Maintenance Standard plan on the same order: $35.00.
- A buyer adds only a KestrelCare Maintenance Basic plan: $20.00.
- A service contract bought later and not sold with the vehicle, and no maintenance plan: none.
